legal.subtitle: Unofficial fan-made reference for a private Blood Bowl league.
legal.paragraph1: Gata Blood Bowl League is an unofficial fan reference. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Games Workshop.
legal.paragraph2: Blood Bowl and related names belong to their respective owners. This site is intended to document league-specific house rules and help players navigate their local league.
legal.paragraph3: Base game wording is referenced through Blood Bowl Base where appropriate instead of being reproduced here in full.

pre.title: Match preparation
pre.prepareIntro: Confirm the roster, conditions and inducements before the first kick-off.
pre.fansIntro: Each coach rolls D3 and adds Dedicated Fans. Record the tabletop result.
pre.weatherIntro: Choose the league weather table. Each coach rolls D6; add the results.
pre.missingPlayers: Available: {available}. You may play with this roster or optionally add journeymen (up to {count}) to reach seven.
pre.rosterReady: Available players: {available}. The squad is ready.
pre.ctvExclusions: Treasury, Dedicated Fans, assistants and cheerleaders do not contribute to CTV.
pre.lowCost: Low Cost Linemen: linemen hiring fees are excluded; advancements still count.
pre.rosterLocked: Roster confirmed. Your opponent must confirm theirs before purchases begin.
pre.journeymanNotice: Temporary linemen with Loner (4+). No treasury spend; their value enters CTV.
pre.noJourneymanPositions: This team's roster has no Lineman positions.
pre.waitPurchase: Waiting for {team} to confirm the first selection.
pre.noInducements: No inducements selected. You may continue without purchases.
pre.provisionalCtv: CTV and compensation are provisional until both rosters are locked.
pre.mercenariesUnavailable: Mercenaries are unavailable: their hiring rules have not been defined for Gata.
pre.recordTabletop: Record physical dice and randomly selected players. Effects that trigger during a drive stay on your match sheet.
pre.kickoffIntro: Both coaches roll D6. The winner decides whether to kick or receive.
pre.reviewIntro: Both coaches confirm the same preparation. Treasury is deducted only when the match starts.
pre.setupReminder: Before each drive: set up up to seven available players. Follow the league's Line of Scrimmage, specialist and wide-zone limits. Field your available captain and resolve inducement triggers and the kick-off event at the table.
pre.treasuryNotice: Only the required contribution is spent from treasury. Unused Petty Cash and tier allowance expire.
pre.started: Match started. The saved preparation is read-only.
pre.closed: This fixture is closed for preparation changes.
pre.choiceUnavailable: This choice is currently unavailable. See the reason beside the item.

error.MATCH_WAIT: Finish the preceding step or wait for your opponent.
error.MATCH_BUDGET: The selection exceeds the available budget by {missing}k.
error.MATCH_STAR_LIMIT: The maximum is {maximum} Star Player choices.
error.MATCH_ROSTER_LIMIT: The match roster cannot exceed {maximum} players.
error.MATCH_POSITION_LIMIT: The match roster allows at most {maximum} players at {position}.
error.MATCH_EFFECTS: Record all required rolls, players and skills for purchased effects.
error.MATCH_KICKOFF: The roll-off winner chooses the receiving team. Ties must be rerolled.
error.MATCH_STARTED: This match has already started. Its preparation is read-only.
error.MATCH_ROSTER_CHANGED: A team has changed. Reload and confirm the new match roster.
error.MATCH_REVISION: The preparation changed on another device. Review the latest version.
post.title: Post-match checklist
post.draftNotice: Changes are staged until both coaches confirm.
post.resultIntro: Record the score and SPP-eligible CAS. Both coaches must agree.
post.specialWinner: Winner for technical wins or concessions
post.replaceResult: Replace result and reset both drafts
post.waitResult: Waiting for the other coach to agree.
post.fansIntro: Record your tabletop roll and income conditions.
post.drawFans: A draw leaves Dedicated Fans unchanged.
post.stalling: This team was deemed to be Stalling
post.incomeExplanation: Normal winnings: half the combined final Fan Factors, plus your TD and 1 without Stalling, all ×10k. Include prayers and +{bonus}k for painting.
post.playersIntro: Enter this match only. TD/CAS must match the score. Stars earn no SPP. Record final injuries after treatment and regeneration.
post.optionalAdvancement: Advancement is optional. Spend some SPP or keep all of it for later.
post.rookieProtection: Team game {number} of the first three: all injuries count as Badly Hurt.
post.manualMvp: Roll the MVP die at the table and choose its recipient here. Each award gives 5 SPP.
post.noMvp: This result awards no MVP to your team.
post.offlineRolls: Choose the result of your tabletop skill or characteristic roll.
post.favouredSkill: Bonus skill if triggered · random when required
post.retire: Temporarily retire for the season (Lasting Injury)
post.rosterIntro: Hire players and staff, sell players or keep journeymen. Purchases use match winnings and treasury.
post.raise: Raise a free Lineman · Masters of Undeath
post.journeymenIntro: Hire to keep SPP and remove temporary Loner. Unhired journeymen leave.
post.sellLimit: Voluntary sales cannot leave fewer than seven. Deaths may leave a smaller roster; a match can start short.
post.financePending: Closing treasury is provisional: record all required Expensive Mistakes dice.
post.financeIntro: Choose an optional safe deposit, then resolve Expensive Mistakes using the remaining treasury.
post.waitStatistics: Both coaches must finish SPP and injuries before treasury risks: prayers may change income.
post.safeNotice: Safe funds are unavailable until season end.
post.extraRoll: Extra roll · D3 for Minor, D6 for Catastrophe
post.riskTreasury: Treasury for the risk table: {amount}. Below 100k no roll is needed.
post.nextIntro: Review availability, team value and captain.
post.nextReminder: Previous MNG clears; new injuries and retirement remain. Temporary effects expire.
post.reviewIntro: Confirm your side. Once both coaches confirm, finish to apply all changes once.
post.completed: Post-match completed. Changes applied to both teams.
post.reopenNotice: Keeps statistics and MVP. Resets new advancements, purchases and finances; the opponent rechecks treasury risks.
post.rosterChanged: The saved roster changed. Reset your side before continuing.
post.resetDraft: Reset my choices using the current roster
post.entryIntro: Record result, SPP, MVP, injuries, purchases and treasury. Advancement is optional; friendlies earn no LP.
post.mistake.major: Major Incident · halve treasury, round down to 5k
error.POST_VALUE: Enter a valid non-negative whole number.
error.POST_DICE: Enter the result of a D{maximum} roll.
error.POST_STATISTICS: Player TD and CAS totals must match the result. Technical wins have no played TD or CAS.
error.POST_MVP: Choose the required MVP recipient(s) from eligible players.
error.POST_PLAYER: This player is unavailable for this action.
error.POST_FAVOURED: Record the Favoured of roll and a legal bonus skill when it triggers.
error.POST_ADVANCEMENT: This advancement is unavailable: check SPP, access and the chosen grant.
error.POST_STAT_LIMIT: This characteristic cannot be improved further.
error.POST_POSITION: The roster or position limit has been reached.
error.POST_SELL: Selling this player would leave fewer than seven rostered players.
error.POST_BUDGET: The treasury cannot cover this purchase or safe deposit.
error.POST_RAISE: This free Lineman requires Masters of Undeath and a recorded opposition death.
error.POST_ACTION: This action is unavailable at the current post-match step.
error.POST_RESULT: Both coaches must agree the result first.

error.POST_INCOMPLETE: Both coaches must complete and confirm their post-match checklists.

post.noPlayerChanges: No new SPP, injuries or advancements.

teamRoster.prep.banner: Hiring, selling and missed matches reset the steps «{roster}», «{inducements}» and «{kickoff}». Fans and weather stay.
teamRoster.prep.bannerPhone: Hiring, selling, missed matches and SPP edits reset the steps «{roster}», «{inducements}» and «{kickoff}». Fans and weather stay.
teamRoster.match.title: Match on · {match}
teamRoster.match.sub: Taps are recorded in {target}: they show in the career at once and fill in the post-match by themselves. Hiring, selling, advancement and the treasury — after the post-match.
teamRoster.match.subDesk: The counters of the player on the right write records into {target}: they show in the career at once (the green index in the table) and fill in the post-match by themselves. Hiring, selling, advancement and the treasury — after the post-match.
teamRoster.match.outsideSub: Taps change the career but will not go into {target} or its post-match. Switch it off to record the match again.
teamRoster.match.outsideSubDesk: Edits change the career but will not go into {target}.
teamRoster.match.outsideCaption: fix an old mistake without touching {target}
teamRoster.matchNote: MVP — in the post-match. Advancement and sales — after it.
teamRoster.mvpInPost: The MVP is picked in the post-match
teamRoster.injury.title: Injury in the match
teamRoster.injuryCaption.badly-hurt: no lasting effect after the match
teamRoster.injuryCaption.niggling: a Niggling Injury and a missed match
teamRoster.injuryCaption.lasting: −1 to a characteristic and a missed match
teamRoster.injury.note: It is recorded in this match ({match}) and fills in the post-match's Players step, where the injury is applied to the roster. While the team has played fewer than 3 matches, any injury becomes Badly Hurt.
teamRoster.injury.unsure: The records could not be read: whether the injury was recorded is not known.
teamRoster.hire.title: Hire players
teamRoster.hire.sub: {race} · on the roster {players} of {max} · places left: {free}
teamRoster.hire.numbers: Numbers of the new players: {numbers} — change them in the player's profile
teamRoster.market.closed: Hiring and selling — after the post-match
teamRoster.market.matchDropped: A match has begun, so the hires and sales that were waiting were not saved. Make them again after the post-match.
teamRoster.sell.title: Sell the player
teamRoster.sell.backFate: Back to the treasury · full value and injuries
teamRoster.sell.note: The player leaves the team for good: SPP, skills and improvements are lost. Half the player's current value comes back. Nobody can be sold while the roster has 7 players or fewer.
teamRoster.sell.noteFate: The player leaves the team for good: SPP, skills and improvements are lost. Architect of Fate: the player's full value comes back, and 10k for each injury. Nobody can be sold while the roster has 7 players or fewer.
teamRoster.sell.cancelNote: This player was bought after the last match, so the full price comes back. Once a match starts the purchase cannot be cancelled.
teamRoster.sell.captain: {name} is the captain: the team has none until you name another in a player's profile.
teamRoster.sell.noId: This player has no id in the roster and cannot be sold. Ask the league administrator to fix the roster.
teamPlayer.matchDropped: A match has begun, so the player edits and advancements that were waiting were not saved. Make them again after the post-match.
teamPlayer.favoured.held: The player has this skill already.
teamPlayer.favoured.unknown: This skill is not on the bonus list.
teamPlayer.refusal.FAVOURED_SKILL_UNKNOW: {skill} is not on the team's favoured list
teamPlayer.refusal.FAVOURED_SKILL_NOT_HI: {skill} is not one of the player's favoured skills
teamPlayer.refusal.SKILL_NOT_EXTRA: {skill} came with an advancement: undo the advancement instead
teamPlayer.refusal.DICE_ROLL_MISMATCH: A roll on the site was rerolled against this skill, so it stays.
teamPlayer.title: Player
teamPlayer.noInjuries: No injuries and no Niggling Injuries
teamPlayer.gone: This player is no longer on the roster.
teamPlayer.edit.closed: Number, name and captain — after the post-match
teamPlayer.edit.title: Edit the player
teamPlayer.edit.name: Name
teamPlayer.edit.note: Opponents see the number and the name in the roster and in the match report
teamPlayer.edit.sppNote: Each press is saved at once.
teamPlayer.edit.changed: The player's number, name or captaincy has changed — open the edit again
teamPlayer.fix.open: Fix by hand: injuries, characteristics, contract, skills
teamPlayer.fix.saveFirst: Save or cancel the edit first
teamPlayer.fix.title: Fix by hand
teamPlayer.fix.changed: The player's data has changed — open the fix again
teamPlayer.fix.sub: What was settled at the table otherwise than the site recorded
teamPlayer.fix.healNote: Take off only what was marked by mistake: «Back on the roster» keeps an injury's effects.
teamPlayer.noId: This player has no id in the roster, so nothing can be saved for this player. Ask the league administrator to fix the roster.
teamPlayer.undo.title: Undo the advancement?
teamPlayer.undo.site: The site's roll goes back to the player: the next «{type}» takes the same roll; there is no new roll before that.
teamPlayer.undo.table: The advancement can be taken again at any time.
teamPlayer.undo.bare: This advancement does not say what it gave: only its SPP come back.
teamPlayer.undo.changed: The last advancement has changed — nothing was undone.
teamPlayer.favoured.title: {alignment}: a bonus skill
teamPlayer.favoured.sub: Roll a D8 at the table: on a {trigger} the player gains one of these skills, at no cost to the value.
teamPlayer.favoured.random: Without Mutation in the primary access the skill is chosen at random — roll for it at the table too.
teamPlayer.favoured.label: Bonus skill
teamPlayer.roll.none: The site has no such roll
teamPlayer.career.title: Career
teamPlayer.career.note: Actions are recorded by taps on the roster and in the post-match. A line that waits for the post-match is in the career already, and stays once both coaches finish the match. Edits outside a match are a line of their own. Matches before the site's records are not listed.
teamAdvance.refusal.NO_SKILL_LEFT: The player has every skill of these categories
teamAdvance.refusal.GRANT_NOT_AVAILABLE: {skill} cannot be taken with this advancement
teamAdvance.refusal.GRANT_WRONG_KIND: This advancement does not give that
teamAdvance.refusal.ROLL_STALE: Came up: {skills} — the player has it all already: the roll cannot be taken. Take a skill off, or take this advancement at the table.
teamAdvance.refusal.ROLL_REROLLED: This roll was rolled again past {skills}, which the player has no more: give the skill back before taking the roll, or take this advancement at the table.
teamAdvance.refusal.DICE_ROLL_USED: Undo the later advancement first: its roll was taken after this one.
teamAdvance.title: Advancement
teamAdvance.chosenHint: Next, only the skills of this category the player does not have yet.
teamAdvance.col.emptyType: Choose the type of advancement first
teamAdvance.via.label: How it is rolled
teamAdvance.note.site: The site rolls both dice and keeps the result — no rerolling it
teamAdvance.note.siteDie: The site rolls the die and keeps the result — no rerolling it
teamAdvance.note.table: Mark the two skills the dice showed
teamAdvance.note.tableOne: Mark the skill the die showed
teamAdvance.note.rolledSite: Rolled on the site · the result is kept and seen in the player's history
teamAdvance.note.rolledTable: Rolled at the table · the history will say «at the table»
teamAdvance.randomHint: Two D16s on the league's Skill Table, each a skill the player lacks, and different: the coach takes one of the two. A blank face, a skill the player has and the first die's skill are rolled again.
teamAdvance.rollResult: Two D16s on the category's table
teamAdvance.rollResultOne: A D16 on the category's table
teamAdvance.marksFull: Each die is marked — take a mark off first
teamAdvance.attempt.blank: {face} — no skill on this face, rolled again
teamAdvance.otherCategory: The roll is made already — in {category}
teamAdvance.kept: The roll stays the player's: close this now, and the next advancement of this type takes the same roll
teamAdvance.lost: The roll's answer did not come: press again — the site gives the same roll back
teamAdvance.waiting.stat: A D8 for a characteristic waits for this player: take «Characteristic improvement» first — the site gives that roll back
teamAdvance.waiting.random_skill: A random skill's roll waits for this player: take «Random primary skill» first — the site gives that roll back
teamAdvance.statWait: The roll decides what may improve
teamAdvance.instead: Take a skill in place of the characteristic
teamAdvance.insteadSub: A primary or secondary skill of your choice, at the characteristic's price · {cost} SPP
teamAdvance.insteadTitle: Skill in place of a characteristic · {cost} SPP
teamAdvance.col.emptyD8: Roll the D8 — the characteristics it allows appear here
teamAdvance.bind: Record this roll for the advancement «{skill}» taken at the table
teamSettings.refusal.LEAGUE_UNKNOWN: The race has no such league
teamSettings.refusal.FAVOURED_UNKNOWN: The race has no such Favoured of…
teamSettings.refusal.RACE_SAME: The team is of this race already
teamSettings.refusal.RACE_IN_SEASON: A team playing in the season keeps its race
teamSettings.refusal.DICE_ROLL_MISMATCH: A roll on the site was rerolled against a favoured skill this change takes off: that skill stays, so nothing was saved.
teamSettings.title: Team settings
teamSettings.name: Name
teamSettings.orderNote: Players in the order of their numbers
teamSettings.orderSame: The roster is in number order already
teamSettings.live: A match is on — the settings wait for its post-match
teamSettings.waitRoster: Wait until the roster's edits are saved
teamSettings.writing: A save of the team is on its way
teamSettings.changed: The team was changed on another device: look at it and save again
teamSettings.unknown: No answer came: the site is reading the team again — check whether it was saved
teamSettings.raceDrops: All players of the roster ({count}) leave; the treasury, the resources and the history stay
teamSettings.raceStaff: What the new race cannot hold goes too, with no money back: {list}
teamSettings.racePreparing: A match is being prepared: change the race after it
teamSettings.prep: Any save of the settings resets the steps «{roster}», «{inducements}» and «{kickoff}». Fans and weather stay.
treasury.changedElsewhere: The team was changed elsewhere — perhaps by this very change, if its answer was lost. Check the history before you make it again.
treasury.fix.sub: A change of the treasury goes into the history as a correction by hand
treasury.fix.title: Correct by hand
treasury.gamesUnknown: Could not check whether a match is on: a change now may keep a post-match from finishing.
treasury.history.unreadable: The server's answer could not be read.
treasury.liveSub: The treasury and the resources wait for the post-match: a change now would keep it from finishing.
treasury.lock.startingRerolls: Starting rerolls are bought only while the team is being built
treasury.lock.teamRerolls: Team Rerolls open once the team leaves the build
treasury.mayHaveWritten: No answer came — the change may have been saved. Check the history before you make it again.
treasury.money.amountHelp: In thousands, with at most one decimal: 42.5
treasury.money.noteLong: The comment is longer than {max} characters
treasury.prepSub: A purchase, a change of the treasury or of the team's settings resets the steps «{roster}», «{inducements}» and «{kickoff}». Fans and weather stay.
treasury.resources.mayHaveSaved: No answer came — the change may have been saved. Check the counters before you make it again.
treasury.resources.note: Lowering a counter gives back the price only of what the team bought on top of its build.
treasury.resources.sub: A purchase is paid from the treasury
treasury.safeRule: Up to 50k of the winnings after each match. It can be spent only after the season.
treasury.strip.edit: Add to or take from the treasury
treasury.title: Treasury and resources
treasury.writing: Another save is still on its way. Wait a moment and press again.
